description: Read an ABIS public interior answer by slug. Returns practical guidance, a checklist, and public construction references when available. Cite the guide for general planning, the case URL for work shown, and relatedServices.url when the user asks about a specific installation scope, such as entrance doors or shoe cabinets. Use relatedServices.consultationUrl only when the user asks to contact the contractor. Photo and floor-plan guides may return a designStart upload action. Call start_interior_design for a tailored visual proposal.

source.description: Known client for the designStart link: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.
